title: OpenWeatherMap Current Weather
description: Fetches current weather data for a list of major US cities from the OpenWeatherMap API. Requires a free API key (sign up at openweathermap.org). Returns temperature, humidity, wind speed, and conditions.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone

# OpenWeatherMap - free tier: 1000 calls/day
# Sign up: https://openweathermap.org/api
API_KEY = CREDENTIALS['api_key']
BASE_URL = 'https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/weather'

# Major US cities to monitor
cities = [
    {'name': 'New York', 'lat': 40.7128, 'lon': -74.0060},
    {'name': 'Los Angeles', 'lat': 34.0522, 'lon': -118.2437},
    {'name': 'Chicago', 'lat': 41.8781, 'lon': -87.6298},
    {'name': 'Houston', 'lat': 29.7604, 'lon': -95.3698},
    {'name': 'Phoenix', 'lat': 33.4484, 'lon': -112.0740},
]

rows = []
for city in cities:
    params = {
        'lat': city['lat'],
        'lon': city['lon'],
        'appid': API_KEY,
        'units': 'imperial',
    }
    resp = requests.get(BASE_URL, params=params, timeout=30)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    data = resp.json()

    rows.append({
        'city': city['name'],
        'temp_f': data['main']['temp'],
        'feels_like_f': data['main']['feels_like'],
        'humidity_pct': data['main']['humidity'],
        'pressure_hpa': data['main']['pressure'],
        'wind_speed_mph': data['wind']['speed'],
        'wind_deg': data['wind'].get('deg', 0),
        'weather': data['weather'][0]['main'] if data.get('weather') else '',
        'description': data['weather'][0]['description'] if data.get('weather') else '',
        'clouds_pct': data.get('clouds', {}).get('all', 0),
        'visibility_m': data.get('visibility', 0),
        '_epoch': data.get('dt', int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())),
    })
    time.sleep(0.25)  # Be kind to free tier rate limits

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
